rows.explanation: Editorial framing is retained in the immutable source; it adds no separate model mechanism.

Local connectivity, shared parameters, temporal state and learned pairwise mixing have explicit forward/backward cases; the practice treats family choice as candidate generation followed by hard constraints.
rows.not_adopted: No fixed total ordering of architecture quality or sample requirements.

rows.explanation: Named profiles illustrate distinct workloads; model parameter/activation/operator ledgers are separated in the destinations.
rows.not_adopted: Historical catalogue values and illustrative utilization are not current device measurements.

rows.explanation: Work, stored state, actual traffic, dtype and execution phase are separated; roofline and Transformer ledgers have worked numbers.
rows.not_adopted: Family labels alone do not determine arithmetic intensity, peak residency or latency.

rows.topic: MLPs: patterns, algorithm, mapping and implications
rows.explanation: Affine map, parameter count, nonlinear composition, loss/backward and batched GEMM already have complete examples; Tensor/GPU chapters supply shapes, layout and tiling.
rows.not_adopted: Finite-data quality and universal-approximation existence do not guarantee optimization or deployment performance.

rows.explanation: Shared local filters, spatial axes/channels and their gradient sums are worked numerically; geometric equivariance is treated separately.
rows.not_adopted: Translation equivariance does not imply arbitrary pose invariance; padding and stride qualify it.

rows.explanation: Channels, padding/stride/dilation, pooling, exact C4 lifting, transformed feature fields and full original escnn animations are integrated.
rows.not_adopted: Group-equivariant feature types are not Conv2d(groups); arbitrary rotations require resampling.

rows.explanation: Complete native window-row SVG, both input channels, all outputs 356/392/464/500 and transposed unfold explain lowering and duplicated entries.
rows.not_adopted: Source row/column caption corrected adjacent; generic im2col 5–10x speedup not adopted.

rows.topic: CNN compute, movement and efficient variants
rows.explanation: MAC convention, depthwise-plus-pointwise constraint, parameter counts and explicit traffic bounds are retained.
rows.not_adopted: Fewer FLOPs do not ensure a proportional speedup on either mobile CPUs or data-centre GPUs.

rows.explanation: The CNN explains spatial/channel factorization; the practice now gives its general cost ratio and distinguishes an always-on audio trigger from a visual species classifier.
rows.not_adopted: Number of output classes alone does not establish representational capacity, and an architecture name does not establish whole-device power.

rows.explanation: Scalar forward/BPTT, actual language-model training, input projections, chunks versus truncation, multilayer dependency grid and weight-gradient reductions are present.
rows.not_adopted: Parallel input projection does not remove the hidden-state dependency or make generated future inputs available.

rows.topic: Attention: algorithm, mapping, memory and movement
rows.explanation: Finite Q/K/V example, scores/softmax, all projection gradients, permutation qualification, training/generation and materialized cost are explained; non-identifiability has a finite worked example.
rows.not_adopted: Input-dependent dense weights do not require random addressing or a dynamic execution graph; square score storage is implementation-specific.

rows.explanation: Encoder/decoder/cross-attention, masks/PAD, shifted loss, residual/norm/FFN, modern causal block and phase-specific memory/parallel ownership have detailed examples.
rows.not_adopted: 2017 translator, modern decoder-only model, training activations and autoregressive KV state are not interchangeable.

rows.explanation: Exact source interaction method, pooled IDs including empties/repeats, Gram order, BCE, gradients, table/row/column ownership and three original TorchRec figures are integrated.
rows.not_adopted: Sparse access is not universally uncacheable or the sole bottleneck for every DLRM shape; GB and GiB remain distinct.

rows.explanation: Shared maps, skip paths, normalization and multiplicative gates are developed in their own chapters rather than duplicated as a second introduction.
Rows, shared token-wise weights, expansion dimensions and both projection gradients are explicit.
Identity target, compatible shapes, direct gradient branch and projection shortcut are worked.
Scalar and matrix derivative products, initialization assumptions, active/dead paths and cancellation are explicit.
rows.not_adopted: Spectral radius bounds on individual changing Jacobians do not establish the asserted product bound.

rows.explanation: I+J_F, F=-x cancellation, post-addition ReLU, full pre/post Jacobians and executable ResNet-18 are retained.
rows.not_adopted: A shortcut does not guarantee unchanged or nonzero gradients; historical evidence is not universal performance.

rows.explanation: Axes, train/eval statistics, numerical examples, LN/RMS VJP, epsilon, shift-null direction and normalization placement are explained.
rows.not_adopted: Universal Jacobian spectrum [0.5,2], fixed minimum batch size and inversion of arbitrary batch statistics are rejected.

rows.explanation: Sigmoid/SiLU gates, both branch gradients, parameter-matched widths and local TP reconstruction have worked cases.
rows.not_adopted: Dense gating is not sparse expert routing; a historical kernel timing is not universal LLM throughput.

rows.explanation: The existing explanations connect composition to activation lifetime, recomputation, precision and kernel traffic.
rows.not_adopted: No universal normalization speedup or optimization guarantee is adopted.

rows.explanation: Contraction/broadcast axes, exact convolution windows, stable reductions and a full reduction tree with original animation have explicit cases.
rows.not_adopted: Four-way fan-in art does not establish a reduction's work/depth or near-peak execution.

rows.explanation: Transpose versus reshape, strides, counted sectors, banks/XOR, indexed operations and source contracts are represented.
rows.not_adopted: Cache-sector counts are not unconditionally HBM traffic; model-family tags are not access-pattern proofs.

rows.explanation: Gather/scatter with repeated indices, transpose gradients, rooted versus all-rank outputs and uneven all-to-all are worked; original source diagrams retained.
rows.not_adopted: Local indexing and network collectives are different; no universal 10x gather penalty is transferred.

rows.explanation: Tiling/fusion, neutral masks and synchronization, work/traffic bounds, stored state, streams and ownership are already explicit.
rows.not_adopted: No universal energy ratio, fixed hardware utilization or peak-performance guarantee is adopted.

rows.explanation: Candidate family, required task quality and resource constraints are distinguished.
Mappings generate candidates; all candidates re-enter hard constraint checks.
rows.not_adopted: A data modality does not have exactly one admissible architecture.

rows.explanation: Shapes, batch/context scaling, MAC versus FLOP, stored activation versus transfer bytes and operator-specific terms are retained.
rows.not_adopted: One architecture-wide fitted exponent cannot replace an operator ledger.

rows.explanation: Latency/throughput, critical dependency paths, failures, model/activation/optimizer state and operating envelope are separated.
rows.not_adopted: Fixed family efficiency ranges and mandatory square attention residency are not transferred.

rows.explanation: Full Winograd 1D/2D derivation, channel GEMM, valid tiling, precision counterexample, GEMM tiling, fusion and scoped numerical formats are integrated.
rows.not_adopted: 2.25 counts variable products, not time; no blanket FP16 impossibility or universal tile size.

rows.explanation: Complete native selection SVG, unchanged four-step English procedure and five checked constraints are integrated.
rows.not_adopted: The flow suggests candidates rather than proving them deployable; a failed quality check cannot be waived by a score.

rows.explanation: Actual sharing, state and mixing assumptions are explained and the practice distinguishes assigned bias indices from learning curves.
rows.not_adopted: No universal scalar hierarchy of architectural bias or guaranteed sample-count reduction is adopted.

rows.explanation: Work times event rate and conditional sustained service capacity are distinguished; 75 ms per event is compared explicitly with sequential 30-fps arrival.
rows.not_adopted: Peak arithmetic headroom alone does not prove latency, sustained utilization, power or backlog stability.

rows.explanation: Source constants reconstructed: partial memory 65.045056 MB, matched-unit conditional 75 ms, active energy 1.5 J/day; completed disjoint-state battery example separates idle draw and event rate.
rows.not_adopted: Source floating/integer work mismatch, inferred 90% quality, capacity from class count, automatic GPU exclusion and arbitrary 10% future capacity are not accepted.

rows.explanation: Complexity/quality, biased candidate selection, data requirements, state, traffic and hardware dependence are tied to concrete explanations and counterexamples.
rows.not_adopted: Illustrative percentages and catalogue anecdotes do not become empirical findings by appearing in a recap.

rows.explanation: Existing chapter transitions and worked constraints provide the synthesis; the complete original recap stays available in the course archive.
rows.not_adopted: No mandatory quadratic resident score matrix or fixed family bottleneck is adopted.
